sections.name: DataLabel
sections.title: Label and value display
sections.what: Draws the label and value, shows a dash for empty values, and adds bold when asked.
sections.why: Likely reason: a missing fact should look clearly missing rather than blank.
sections.watch_out: The red flag name is misleading; it only adds weight, so do not rely on it to show a warning.

summary: Shows a small label above a value, with a dash when the value is empty.
purpose: Gives facts in cards and drawers one consistent look.
why: Likely reason: one shared style for displayed facts.
how: Draws a small grey label, then the value below. Shows a dash when the value is null, undefined or blank. Can add extra bold and extra style classes.
inputs: A label text, a value (text or display content), an optional bold flag, and optional extra classes.
risks: The bold flag only adds weight. Despite its name it does not change the colour to red.
debug: If a value shows a dash unexpectedly, check that the value is actually null or blank.
